messages.subject: Google Group Deprecation
messages.body_plain: The Google group list serve will be replaced by our bioBakery Discourse site on [23rd Dec, 2019]. The Google group list serve will still remain open with the new Discourse Forum <http://forum.biobakery.org/> site for posting and will be read only once sunset. Please direct all new queries to our new bioBakery discourse forum: https://forum.biobakery.org/.

messages.subject: What to choose as fixed effects and random effects?
messages.subject_clean: What to choose as fixed effects and random effects?
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

Does anybody have insights on what is fixed effects or random effects?

Is that random effects are confounders?

If I have one var A that is highly correlated with B, should I put both of them to be fixed or one to be random?

Thank you!

Angel
